headline: Southwest Gas Holdings misses revenue estimates despite earnings beat
summary: Southwest Gas Holdings reported quarterly earnings that beat analyst estimates by $0.02, while revenue fell short of consensus expectations.
why: Southwest Gas Holdings operates regulated natural gas distribution utilities, making its financial results important for utility sector investors.

impacts.name: Southwest Gas Holdings Inc
impacts.why: Mixed earnings results with a revenue miss create conflicting fundamental signals for equity valuation.
